question: The lolicon read Beatrice’s soul as that of a loli, but do the souls of spirits not grow? Also, is Garfiel’s soul also something of a lolicon?
answer: It’s not that the souls of spirits don’t grow, but spirit or human, cooped up in the same place for four hundred years, you won’t grow if you’re making progress. Garfiel is rushing full-speed towards chuuni, so the main question is whether he’ll be able to advance mentally to fourteen years old (literally: allow fourteen years of age inside his defense radius).
